creative_objective: Recreate the winning before/after reference exactly with the user's bottle, now speaking to the jeans that fit loose at the back: the viewer sees the contrast between the jeans that never fit and curves that show, with the bottle as the bridge between both photos, and the bottom cards and offer bar removing objections (easy, cash on delivery, natural, no needles).

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) ANTES / DESPUÉS headers with their subtitles together with the two back-view photos. 2) The bottle in the center over the split line. 3) The offer bar and the four benefit cards.
art_direction.composition_style: Symmetric vertical split down the middle of the upper 68% of the canvas; the bottle overlaps the split line; full-width bottom section with a row of four equal cards and a full-width pill bar.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Header blocks about 12% of the height across the full width (left half plum, right half fuchsia). Photo panels from below the headers to about 68% of the height, each 50% of the width. Card row about 18% of the height with small even gaps and side margins. Offer pill bar about 11% of the height with small margins, near the bottom edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Left photo: soft, flat, slightly cool indoor daylight. Right photo: warm golden-hour sunlight and glowing sky. Bottle: crisp studio lighting with soft shadow, sharpest element. Bottom: soft fuchsia glow behind the cards and the bar.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 photorealistic before/after split-screen supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. TOP (about 12% of the height, full width): two flat solid header blocks side by side; the left half is dark plum #2B1226 with the white word 'ANTES' in a very heavy geometric uppercase sans-serif and below it a two-line white subtitle in a rounded bold sans-serif, all centered in the left half; the right half is hot fuchsia #E6177F with the white word 'DESPUÉS' in the same heavy uppercase sans-serif and a two-line white subtitle below it, centered in the right half. The headers and subtitles are the same size on both sides. MIDDLE (from below the headers to about 68% of the height): a vertical split screen with a thin clean dividing line, two real photographs of the same young adult Latina woman with long dark wavy hair in a ponytail, seen from behind from head to mid-thigh, camera at hip height. LEFT PHOTO: a bright, simple bedroom with a white bed and wooden headboard and soft flat daylight; she wears a white t-shirt knotted at the lower back and grey cotton biker shorts; her silhouette looks flatter and less defined. RIGHT PHOTO: a tropical beach at golden sunset with turquoise sea, gentle waves and palm trees on the horizon, warm glowing light; she wears a coral bikini with a tasteful full-coverage bottom; her silhouette looks curvier, rounder and toned, confident posture. CENTER: the product stands upright, front-facing, exactly over the split line, from just below the headers to the top edge of the card row, about 48% of the height and 24% of the width, crisp studio lighting and a soft shadow. The product is a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; the black label shows a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh underline, three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by plus signs ('200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA'), and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. No stickers, seals or badges on or next to the bottle. BELOW THE PHOTOS (about 18% of the height): a full-width row of four equal rounded cards with small even gaps, filled with deep magenta #B0105E fading to dark plum #2B1226, each with a thin glowing fuchsia #E6177F border; each card has a white thin-line icon on top (card 1: two capsules; card 2: an open hand holding a delivery box; card 3: three rising bars; card 4: a shield with a check mark) and centered heavy uppercase white text below; in card 1 the last line is bubblegum pink #FF8CC0. BOTTOM (about 11% of the height): an almost full-width pill-shaped bar in deep magenta to dark plum with a bubblegum pink border; on its left two lines of heavy uppercase text, the first white and the second much larger in bubblegum pink with small pink rays on both sides; a thin vertical white divider; on its right a glossy pale blush pink #FBE3EE pill with extra-heavy deep magenta #B0105E text. A soft fuchsia glow sits behind the cards and the bar. Do not add any other text, seal, price, logo, button, star or badge.

No nudity, no thong-cut bikini, no sexualized posing; tasteful full-coverage swimwear only.
No arrows, measuring tapes or numbers on the bodies.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
